meaning: A short pause while a video or song loads more data ahead of time. You may see a spinning circle.
clues: A spinning circle shows up on your video.
The picture stops while your device waits for more of the show to arrive.
A slow internet connection is the usual cause.
Your device saves a little extra ahead of time, so the video can keep going if the signal dips.
It is one word with nine letters. It starts with B.
